title: Culture and Values Survey Summary and Continued Discussion
body:
Hi Friends,

Thank you so much for your contributions to the survey. We received responses from **20 active members of the community** - not a bad starting point for this discussion.

**[Here's a link to the summary of the results.](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19KD7fM0x2jwREX_5y4SKkXMastUbLqJQSQZ39byc4IQ/edit?usp=sharing)** I essentially cleaned up the data to make it more readable and removed duplicate responses. In this post, **I will include my own response to the prompts after synthesizing the data and variety of inputs (prior CW and on-going strategy discussions)**. **[Please review the summary before weighing-in.](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19KD7fM0x2jwREX_5y4SKkXMastUbLqJQSQZ39byc4IQ/edit?usp=sharing)**

**This was just step one in this process - although I hope to have us [dis]agree and commit on a bunch of these strategic elements by the end of the month at the latest.**
--------------------
## My strategic distillation of the responses
[These comments are my own and I anticipate disagreement from members of the community at-large _and _members of the Agency. Please be civil - ask questions, state what you disagree with and why. I am coming from a somewhat-outsider perspective, you likely have perspective that I don't.]

**Anticipated meaningful contributions to society and priorities for positioning:**

DAOs and Governance, Web 3 Media, and Interoperability - everything else will be people leveraging the smart contract functionality to realize their own visions.

We stay on the cutting edge as far as Substrate and build specialized tooling to support these other differentiating priorities

**What value is Edgeware currently providing:**

Respondees do not feel like that chain is currently providing much value. It's unclear to them how we're currently solving users' problems other than that we can distribute token they can sell to cover their runway. They are still here and contributing but this emphasizes the need to focus on aligning people
